purpose: Describe an action as burdensome or difficult to carry out.
keywords: This is hard to say to the person concerned.
My foot hurts, making it difficult to walk.
Small print is difficult to read.
restrictions: Often highlights discomfort or personal difficulty; it can overlap with にくい.
mistake: づらい follows a verb stem, not the dictionary form.

segments.role: Describe an action as burdensome or difficult to carry out. ます-stem + づらい.

examples.translation: This is hard to say to the person concerned.
